dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeDescription: Join a band you've been invited to, or start a new one.
dashboard.icsDescription: Add this link to your phone or computer's calendar app to see every band's events alongside your own — it updates automatically.

accountSettings.title: Settings
accountSettings.bandsDescription: Join another band with an invite code, or start a new one.

accountSettings.languageDescription: Applies to your account everywhere — switching here doesn't just change this device.
accountSettings.wakeLockDescription: Keeps this device's display on while Bandstand is open, on any page.

accountSettings.wakeLockUnsupported: Not supported on this browser — there's no way to hold the screen awake here.
accountSettings.wakeLockStageModeNote: Stage Mode always keeps the display on, regardless of this setting.
